hints.title: Connected Index Equivalence
hints.text: Allowed swaps form transitive equivalence classes: any two indices in the same connected component can be swapped.

hints.title: Disjoint Set Grouping
hints.text: Group indices using union-find, then compare multiset frequencies of source and target within each component.

hints.title: Count Multiset Intersection
hints.text: For each component, count matches via frequency counts; unmated elements contribute to the Hamming distance.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: m is number of allowed swaps
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating sequences of swaps leads to factorial states.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Union-find groups reachable positions so matching reduces to multiset intersection in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate models swaps as an undirected graph and groups elements by connected components.
